app.name: Atelier
app.tagline: Create screens on the Laravel repository with Cursor, a branch per person, and a live preview.
app.headline: Ship Laravel screens from a conversation.
app.lede: Each person gets a branch, Cursor in the loop, and a live preview of the portal — mobile, tablet, and desktop.
app.featureCollab: Invite the team, share a preview link
app.featureSpectator: Watch a session without taking the lock

auth.title: Sign in to the studio
auth.subtitle: GitHub is the source of access. This environment falls back to a local login until the GitHub App secrets exist.
auth.localHint: Local login is only for this environment. Production signs in with GitHub and checks repository access.

github.title: GitHub App credentials
github.lede: Create a GitHub App on the ticoncreserv organization. GitHub sends the client id, secret, and private key back to this studio.
github.hint: You need to be an organization owner. GitHub opens a review page, then redirects here with the credentials.
github.configured: GitHub login is configured for this process.
github.saved: GitHub created the app and stored the secrets on this machine. Install it on the target repository next.
github.installHint: Install only on that repository. Do not grant Administration.
github.envHint: Secrets live in {path} (gitignored). Copy them into .env so they survive a restart or another host.
github.permissions: Permissions: contents read and write, metadata read, pull requests read and write, email addresses read. No Administration.
github.oauthHint: A GitHub OAuth App also covers login. Use the same callback URL and set GITHUB_CLIENT_ID and GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.
github.cursorTitle: Cursor ACP is a separate credential
github.cursorHint: GitHub App credentials and CURSOR_API_KEY are required. The studio clones ticoncreserv/app and runs prompts through Cursor ACP. MockProvider is tests-only.
github.blocked: GitHub App setup is disabled in this environment.
github.error: GitHub did not return app credentials. Try again.
github.used: That callback code is single-use. If the app was already created, the secrets are on this machine — install it next.
github.already: Credentials for this GitHub App are already on this machine. Install the app on ticoncreserv/app.
github.webhookHint: GitHub signs membership events with this secret. Paste it as the webhook secret on the app, and use the URL below. GitHub cannot reach 127.0.0.1 — deliveries wait until ATELIER_PUBLIC_URL is public.
github.accessedUrlsHint: Locally the studio answers on the listen port, plus localhost:80 and :8080. In production set ATELIER_PUBLIC_URL to the dedicated https domain — that origin replaces :43123.
github.callbackUrlsHint: Paste these into the GitHub App Callback URL list. Localhost entries are only for this machine. Production uses the public domain from ATELIER_PUBLIC_URL.
github.callbackUrlsSettings: Edit callback URLs on the GitHub App
github.oauthPasteHint: If a leftover callback still 404s, paste the code query here.
github.oauthSubmit: Finish GitHub sign-in with this code
github.oauthError: GitHub did not exchange that install code. Sign in again from this studio.
github.pasteHint: If GitHub opens a callback the browser cannot reach, copy the code query and paste it here.

nav.publishSoon: Publish is a later phase. The flag is off.

workspace.ready: Workspace ready. Opening the preview starts Laravel on this branch.
workspace.hibernated: Workspace hibernated. Resume to start preview processes.
workspace.busy: Another session holds the run lock.
workspace.spectator: Spectator mode — you can watch, not prompt.
workspace.pendingMigrations: {count} migrations in your branch are not applied.
workspace.extraMigrations: {count} migrations exist in the database but not in your branch.
workspace.lockHeld: The run lock is held by another session.
workspace.noMigrations: No migrations have been applied from this studio yet.
workspace.resumeHint: Resume starts php artisan serve and Vite in dev mode so assets compile on demand.
workspace.loadError: The workspace could not be loaded.

chat.empty: Describe the screen or change you want. Mention routes with {'@'} and attach files or a screenshot.
chat.placeholder: Ask the agent to add a page, field, or fix…
chat.droppedContext: {count} context blocks did not fit the prompt budget.
chat.cursorRequired: CURSOR_API_KEY is required. Prompts will not run until it is set in .env.
chat.promptFailed: The prompt did not complete. Try again.
chat.modeHintAgent: Edit the worktree and run tools.
chat.modeHintPlan: Propose a plan before changing files.
chat.recipeHint: The recipe fills the prompt. Type the model or subject, then send.
chat.emptyHint: Start from a recipe, mention a route, or paste a screenshot.
chat.suggestion1: Add an Inertia page that lists quotes
chat.suggestion2: Add a status field to the Quote model

preview.title: Preview
preview.longQuery: Still querying the ERP ({seconds}s). The SQL timeout is 300s.
preview.inspectHint: Click the preview to attach a note to the composer.
preview.debugEmpty: No preview metrics yet. Laravel can postMessage atelier-preview-metrics when it has numbers.
preview.debugFix: Ask the agent to fix the last preview error

rules.title: Rules
rules.hint: Compiled rules become AGENTS.md and .cursor/rules. The agent language follows your locale; code stays in English.
rules.userHint: Your personal preferences for this studio.

invite.title: Invite a teammate
invite.created: Invite link created. They must have GitHub access to ticoncreserv/app.
invite.pending: You signed in, but GitHub does not yet grant access to the repository.
invite.hint: They sign in with GitHub. If the repo is not visible yet, they wait in pending access.

connections.title: External connections
connections.appMigrate: Forward migrations allowed on the portal connection, with a global lock.
connections.empty: No database connections in this worktree .env yet.

flags.title: Platform flags
flags.hint: Flip without a deploy. Publish and extra providers stay off until that phase.

settings.title: Workspace
settings.isolationHint: QUEUE_NAME, CACHE_PREFIX, SESSION_COOKIE, and APP_URL are unique per workspace.
settings.envFileHint: Edit {path} on disk, then Resume preview. Atelier overwrites APP_URL, SESSION_COOKIE, QUEUE_NAME, and CACHE_PREFIX to isolate the workspace.
settings.platformEnvHint: Platform credentials (GitHub, Cursor, ATELIER_PUBLIC_URL) live in the Atelier root .env, not in this worktree.
